title: Jem Carson: Market Crashes Every Thursday–Monday for 5 Weeks

excerpts.label: The pain trade defined
excerpts.insight: Equities down + vol down simultaneously — everyone hedged but hedges don't work in this regime
excerpts.pm_takeaway: SELL Vega. Monthly puts losing P&L even when directionally correct. Pain trade = stair-step lower with vol compression throughout.

excerpts.label: Vega is broken — zero-DTE is the correct hedge
excerpts.insight: In vol-compression regimes, implied vol decays on the way down — options priced at 20 vol when 30 is warranted destroys P&L
excerpts.pm_takeaway: BUY zero-DTE gamma (0DTE straddles/calls), SELL monthly Vega exposure. VIX flat ≠ vol flat — skew steepening destroys long-put P&L.

excerpts.label: Thursday–Monday: 150% of annual declines in one window
excerpts.insight: Carson called this pattern in January — 5 consecutive weeks of Thursday midday to Monday open drawdowns confirmed
excerpts.pm_takeaway: SHORT ES/NQ into Thursday midday. LONG 0DTE puts on Thursday open. FADE Monday morning gap-up squeeze. Pattern persists until vol expands.

excerpts.label: 10-year to 7–8% — steepener is the structural trade
excerpts.insight: Carson predicted zero to 5% in 2021; now calling 7–8% in 2–3 years. Equity yield vs 10yr = hard ceiling on multiples.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: LONG steepener (2s30s or 5s30s). 10yr at 5% triggers institutional rotation + PE/credit deleveraging. Highest-conviction structural trade.

excerpts.label: Positioning is everything — Soros reflexivity applied
excerpts.insight: Positioning itself creates the outcomes it predicts — not just a reflection of views. Short gamma = market must move; long gamma = market dampened.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: MONITOR dealer gamma positioning (negative gamma = trending moves, positive gamma = mean-reversion). Use as a distribution forecasting tool, not a sentiment indicator.
